title: tab-automation agents.json
description: Configurable agents. Each agent maps to an Azure OpenAI chat-completions deployment + system prompt.

id.description: Referenced by workflows as steps[].agent and by the Discord listener.

deployment.description: Legacy Azure deployment name. Prefer provider+model. Supports env:VAR_NAME.

provider.description: Provider id from config/providers.json (azure | openrouter | meta).

model.description: Model/deployment name. Supports env:VAR_NAME. Omit = provider default.

tools.description: Tool allowlist, e.g. ["web_search","mcp:github:search"]. Set in setup wizard only. Omit or ["*"] = all.

output.description: Agent output mode for workflow steps.

outputSchema.description: Max 8 vars, values bool|int|string. Agent forced to emit only this JSON shape.

requiresApproval.description: Tool names needing owner approval on Discord before running.
